headline: Metro Retail earnings rose 31.9% in Jan-Sept
summary: Metro Retail Stores Group reported a 31.9% rise in consolidated net income to P281.3 million for January to September 2026. Net sales grew 1.9% to P29.25 billion on wider margins and efficiencies.
why: Metro Retail Stores Group is a Philippine retailer led by the Gaisano family, and its results indicate consumer spending and margin trends in Philippine retail.
